text:
Sophia: Quick follow-up from the postmortem for INC-2345 — proposing concrete SLO/SLA updates and owners. TL;DR: 99th p50/95 latency targets stayed okay, p99 and tail throughput slipped during the cache-thundering window. Proposal below, need ack + owners. Link: https://redwood.company/postmortem/INC-2345

Ajay: Saw the graphs. Error budget burn was ~12% over 1h which is annoying. Do we have historical pattern for similar cache misses?

Sophia: @Ajay good catch — I pulled last 6 months, there are 3 small spikes after config pushes. Looks like recurring pattern when prefix cache invalidation coincides with bursty traffic.

Ken: Proposal?

Sophia: Proposed actions: 1) Update SLOs: make p99 latency target 650ms (was 500ms) for heavy inference routes, add throughput SLO for /v1/generate (200 req/s sustained) so we stop overcommitting. 2) Dashboards: add run rate + cache-hit heatmap, and an error-budget burn alert at 8%/30m. 3) Ownership: Ajay (metrics + dashboards) due EOD Tue, Maria (runbook + canary playbook) due Fri, Jordan (automation to auto-fallback to smaller model on cache miss) POC in 2 weeks. 4) Postmortem follow-up meeting every 2 weeks until stabilised.

Maria: I can update the runbook. Quick Q: do we want the canary to be traffic-weighted rollout or time-windowed?

Jordan: Recommend traffic-weighted for this one, so we can shift load away from hot prefixes gradually. I'll start a PR for the fallback lambda that swaps model variant when cache miss rate > 10% for 2m. POC ETA 14 days.

Ajay: I'll add the dashboard panels and the alert. For the throughput SLO I need a baseline query — suggestion: avg(throughput[5m]) over 1h windows, rollup to 1m. Any objections to 200 req/s?

Ken: 200 req/s seems OK for Dedicated nodes but for hosted tier we should keep a softer limit and route to cheaper model variants. Add routing policy note to Console rollout.

Sophia: Good point — update: 200 req/s hard SLO for dedicated customers, hosted API gets an error-budget-aware routing policy (will document).

incident-bot: Postmortem INC-2345 created by Sophia. Action items assigned: Ajay (dashboards), Maria (runbook), Jordan (fallback POC). Check-ins scheduled.

Maria: I'll do a short section in the runbook about "cache-thundering" mitigation and include the exact steps to force failover. Will tag @oncall next time we start a manual canary.

Ajay: Dashboard PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/observability/pull/1204. Panels: p50/p95/p99, cache-hit map, error-budget burn. Please review.

Jordan: Created draft for fallback lambda: snippet in PR, test harness next.

Ken: Suggest we add a monthly scoreboard item for recurring incident patterns so product/infra know if this keeps happening. Also recommend a 90-day review of SLOs post-changes.

Sophia: Ack. I'll add recurring incident metric to the SLO dashboard and schedule the 90-day review. Anyone who can't meet deadlines, ping here. Otherwise, consider this the agreed plan. :thumbsup:

Ajay: Ack — will finish dashboards by Tue EOD.

Maria: Ack — runbook updates by Fri.

Jordan: Ack — POC in two weeks.

Ken: Ack — will coordinate routing notes for hosted tier.
